title: Chrome DevTools
description: Documented public performance profiler (Google) for the Performance Optimization Engine capability area.
body:
Chrome DevTools is a documented performance profiler from Google. The built-in browser profiler: flame charts, performance panels, and lighthouse audits finding frontend bottlenecks.

How it works: It works by summing stage latencies and identifying the stage with the largest share of total time.

Documented uses of this capability area include greenfield application generation, legacy system modernization, API platform design, and continuous testing pipelines.
